notes.title: Prime Mover 1 Year Anniversary
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32566126/4cd8743049d54989272e89084de24ab642f1ca02.gif[/img]

notes.title: MORE CONTENT + TRADING CARDS
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32566126/e1fdd305642a9cb3cbaa8aecb9ea904269fe9d97.gif[/img]

[h1]Explore the bugged side of the blueprint![/h1]
Hello, fellow problem solvers! With this update, we bring you the bugged side of the blueprint; a set of extra challenging puzzle variations! The new puzzles unlock when you have completed their regular version, and all have their own leaderboards and histograms. If you're looking for even more mind-bending problems, this is for you!

[h1]Trading cards![/h1]
We now have support for Steam trading cards! You get one card for every hour you play of Prime Mover, and when you have unlocked a set of cards you can turn it into a cool badge for your steam profile. When you craft badges, you will also randomly unlock profile backgrounds and emoticons from the world of Prime Mover.

As always, we'd love for you to share your solutions on our official [url=https://discord.gg/Yx6g2pu] Discord![/url]

[B]Good luck![/B]

notes.title: LINUX and MAC versions now live!
notes.content:
[h1] You asked for it, we made it![/h1]
Prime Mover is now available for Mac and Linux! We've also made the soundtrack downloadable in perfect FLAC format. As always, you can let us know what you think about the game, report bugs and hang out on [url=https://discord.gg/Yx6g2pu]Discord![/url]

[B]Happy problem-solving![/B]

notes.title: UPDATE - New features and bug fixes!
notes.content:
[h1]Hello Prime Movers![/h1]
We'd like to thank everyone for providing the awesome feedback we've received so far, and for enjoying the game! Today we have a big patch for you guys.

[h1]Features:[/h1]
[list]
    [*] Paste in circuit board even though the selection is too big to fit
    [*] Tag circuit boards with colors by clicking middle mouse button
    [*] Hold alt to select the component you’re mousing over
    [*] Updated lock description
    [*] Reordered the first numbers of REORDER to avoid confusion
    [*] Enter integrated circuits when using the select tool
    [*] Hotkeys in tooltips
    [*] Control-z now included as part of the tutorial
    [*] Copy tool now copies by default - hold control to cut
    [*] Copy tool now reverts to copy mode when unselected
    [*] Speed up simulation by pressing fast forward multiple times
    [*] Circuit boards now show a blue + when it has a number in it
    [*] Click on an input to create a breakpoint
    [*] Scrolling though Inputs is inverted on the lower half of the screen
[/list]
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32566126/b349fbb270e11115196d31b641b4c9c9a2d2c35c.gif[/img]
[h1]Fixes:[/h1]
[list]
    [*] Stepping sometimes jumping ahead
    [*] Game would appear in a tiny window
    [*] Two achievements triggering at the wrong time
    [*] The game not booting if you have no enabled audio devices
    [*] Some typos
[/list]

Thank you for helping us make Prime Mover a better game! We hope you've enjoyed the game so far, there's much more to come in the future!


-4Bit Games

notes.title: Prime Mover releases in 2 days!
notes.content:
Hello Humans!

We’re getting close to release! We’ve spent this final week fixing all known bugs and added different text options, so hopefully, things will work as intended for release! If something goes horribly wrong or if you have a feature suggestion (or just want to hang out) we invite you to join the discord at:

https://discord.gg/YbMSTXZ

A bunch of you have asked us about price and platforms. The game will cost USD $14.99. We will ship to Windows first, but we will explore additional options post-release!

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32566126/dd0fc06a4882fa207dce4f519f89a3b18a71ab5a.gif[/img]

We can’t wait to share Prime Mover with you! Only two days left to go!

- Simen @ 4Bit Games
